description:
Cast Rograkh by paying {0}.
Rograkh enters the battlefield, triggering Jedit Ojanen and Cloudstone Curio.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing not to return anything from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Jedit Ojanen trigger, causing you to pay {G} to create a 2/2 Cat Warrior creature token.
The Cat Warrior enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio, returning Rograkh from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Cat Warrior, adding {G}.
Repeat.
